• Microsoft 365 (M365, formerly Office 365) has updated the FedRAMP Marketplace to reflect the product name M365 Government Community Cloud (GCC) rather than MultiTenant (MT). The intent of this update is to align the name on the marketplace with the M365 sales process and the FedRAMP package. The service boundary, control scope, and included applications as defined in the FedRAMP package have not changed. Nor is there a change to the underlying infrastructure and inventory. To be covered by the GCC FedRAMP authorization, customers must purchase a GCC SKU.

• To determine what M365 products you are using, you can reference your contract documentation or visit the Admin Center for your M365 tenant and check Settings > Org Settings > Data Location.

• If you have further questions, please contact M365GovQnA@microsoft.com and cc: your Microsoft account team.
